_comment: Owned by the audio task. All prompts and lines are original wording. Run `npx tsx tools/gen-audio.ts` to generate missing files into public/audio/<id>.mp3 (music into public/audio/music/<id>.mp3). Mirrored by src/client/audio/manifest.ts.
